notes.title: New Trailer & Capsule Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi everyone,[/b][/p][p]I’ve put together a brand new trailer — pure gameplay from the full game. Hope you enjoy it![/p][p]Also, what do you think of the updated capsule art? I feel it captures the sci-fi vibe and the essence of the game much better.[/p][p]Cheers,
[b]OldMan[/b][/p]

notes.title: Unlocks and Sounds
notes.content:
[p]The full release content is ready, and with it the Demo gets its final update! Discover hidden boxes with unlockable ships, trails, and colors, plus 3 new achievements. Enjoy refined sound effects for a more ambient experience. This is the last update before release!

It’s been a while since the last Demo update—let me know if anything went sideways. [/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]OldMan[/p]

notes.title: MEGAKILL in SOLO
notes.content:
I hear you!

"Please make multiplayer achievements available in solo."

It takes time to understand this wish, but there you go, who am I to judge right? You want to complete the hardest Multiplayer achievement in the game in SOLO, I got you!

Junkyard is added. Go to
Multiplayer->Lobbies->Create->Junkyard

And kill those little ships!

"Top1 is now Top GUN!"

Okay, you don't have to grab the first place in the leaderboard. Top5 is good from now on.

Cheers,
OldMan

notes.title: Achievement fix is out!
notes.content:
Achievements (10th level and multikills) are fixed now.

Checking the leaderboard if you have already done the level bound achievements should  now properly work. (Really properly)

Small fixes:
- announcements are fixed
- shard level beam is slower
- the multiplayer FFA is now worldwide. making it possible to play with big pings - that is what you asked for :)

If you wish you can answer one thing in the comments:
How would you categorize this game? What genre is it?

See you,
OldMan

notes.title: More Achievements
notes.content:
More achievements have been added. Basically, the goal is to have fun even during the demo! 

I've noticed that the engine settings are a bit hidden, so there are two achievements related to targeting that area. 

I wanted to reward any adept player who reaches level 10. And, of course, if you finish the game, that's fantastic. 

Killing each other is acceptable; I wanted to properly acknowledge that aspect too with some love.

notes.title: Demo UPDATE - Music and Sound!
notes.content:
The first major update on the Demo is out! There are two original soundtracks for the game with which I am very satisfied. And for mechanical testing purposes, I added backward movement to the ships.

The music and the basic SFX were already completed a year ago, but I had to remove them due to some unfortunate integration issues that were requested by a sound designer who then disappeared, and I did not have time to re-implement them. So, I am in search of a sound designer. However, there is music in the works!

Moving backwards does not really affect solo mode. I expect impacts in free-for-all dogfights. It is a major deviation from the original game. But it is time to make a major deviation :)
